One platform

Every trade function. One screen.

Stop stitching together brokers, forwarders, spreadsheets, and email threads. NIEL COS brings every function of global trade into one operating system.

Customs

AI-assisted entry filing, HTS classification, and PGA compliance in one flow.

Shipments

End-to-end tracking across ocean, air, and drayage with milestone alerts.

Compliance

Continuous screening against FDA, USDA, APHIS, and EPA requirements.

Documents

Invoices, packing lists, and certificates parsed, stored, and linked to entries.

Logistics

Trucking, warehousing, and fulfillment orchestrated around your freight.

Finance

Duty, freight, and landed-cost visibility with pay and financing tools.

AI Assistant

Ask anything about your trade operations — in plain language.

Control Tower

One live view of every shipment, risk, and exception worldwide.
